description: The feature requirement is an 'every-single-day, unconditional' loop (master:9). But daily firing is NOT guaranteed by any deterministic mechanism. There is no cron file, no launchd that runs the daily pass — the only launchd job is the 5-min healthcheck (plist:6 StartInterval 300) which merely restarts the tmux session. The actual daily schedule is delegated to the LLM brain via a STARTUP instruction telling it to 'CronList; if none mentions earn/audit, CronCreate cron=53 7 * * *' (audit-cli.sh:8). This is non-deterministic self-registration: if the brain skips/fails/forgets the CronCreate, or the cron is cleared (cf. memory: openclaw doctor --fix rolls back cron model overrides), the loop silently never fires daily and the healthcheck will not detect it (it only checks tmux liveness, not whether a daily cron exists or last-fired). Contrast clip, whose master entry specifies an actual 'cron :07' (master:21,35). The 'every-day' invariant is therefore unverified and fragile.

evidence.snippet: STARTUP='... FIRST register the recurring driver if absent: CronList; if none mentions earn/audit, CronCreate cron="53 7 * * *" ...'  # daily firing depends on the LLM executing this; healthcheck only restarts tmux
